caveats: Region grid: 60x60=3600 cells (lat 54.46-55.64, lon 16.06-17.24 at 0.02 deg); 3292 sea cells (SST finite on all 92 target days), 308 land cells set to 0. Per-cell thresholds/climatology from baseline 1992-2002 with +-5 calendar-day windows (pools include 1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05); day 60 set to mean of days 59 and 61; wrap-around 31-day centred smoothing applied. 90th percentile computed with numpy nanquantile method='hazen' (Hyndman-Fan type 5). 25 per-cell MHWs found; no gap joining was triggered (all events were single runs of >=5 days).
